purpose: Initial interactive number-theory SFT pilot on the checked prerequisite action release. Supports EXP-026 and EXP-027; does not constitute either full study.
initial_policy: Fresh upstream Qwen/Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct, revision 7ae557604adf67be50417f59c2c2f167def9a775. No historical project warmstart.
data_contract: Use sft_train.jsonl for weight updates and sft_val.jsonl for loss monitoring. No whole-proof rows, research DEV or TEST enter SFT. Completion-only loss; no target truncation.
checkpoint_selection: Use final after all configured epochs. Intermediate checkpoints preserve partial progress and cannot replace final in the declared before/after comparison.
precision: FP32 master weights and AdamW moments; BF16 autocast
notes: Reuse scripts/train/run_sft.py. The managed subprocess enforces the wall cap. A partial run remains partial. No launch is authorized by this configuration.
